subject: planner: revert support sub-merge needEnforceExchanger (#59648)
summary: Changes `MppTask.needEnforceExchanger` to require an exact match (length + per-position column equality) for Hash partitioning instead of calling the previously-added `PhysicalProperty.IsSubset` helper, and deletes that helper (it was unused after this change). The new behavior is conservative (may add extra exchanges) and does not appear to introduce a path that would skip a required exchange for correctness.
